parameters: Elemental Power's gathering more and more — !!
Ehh — ? You're really okay with it??
I'm taking all this power for myself!!
...Tch! Oh great, they just had to show up.

Those guys... turned out
to be useless after all~
Hah? Could it be... you're alone...??
Wait, so what? You came to beat me alone??
One person, no matter how — ... pfft!!
Besides, you're the Wind Crest one...
you can't even block my fire magic — !!

I can't wrap my head around
it — it makes no sense!!
Oh, could it be that you're...
in a huge hurry or something??
Me fusing with the Dark Element...
I've gotta stop everyone from dying
then I'd already be a Demon King — !!
And the Dark Element Power keeps gathering

Even as is, I'm already
impossibly strong...
Perfect timing — let me test my new power

if I accidentally kill you in one turn...
